entities.name: Athenian Assembly
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The principal legislative body of ancient Athens (c. 508–322 BCE), where all male citizens could speak and vote. The Assembly (Ekklesia) is the earliest example of democratic governance in recorded history.
